description: 4 should-trigger + 4 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers reading and updating a Jira issue, a JQL query, and a German phrasing. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbours (writing a commit subject that merely contains a ticket id, opening a GitHub PR, estimating a ticket's size) plus one unrelated counterexample.

queries.q: check Jira for DEV-1234 and summarise the ticket
run a JQL query for my open bugs this sprint
leg ein Jira-Ticket für den Exportfehler an
write the commit message for DEV-1234
queries.note: a ticket id inside a commit subject is conventional-commits-writing, not a Jira call

queries.q: open the pull request for this branch
queries.note: PR creation is /create-pr and git-workflow, even when the PR links a ticket

queries.q: how big is ticket DEV-1234, should we split it?
